title: Three-Day Agreement
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji was finalizing the details with everyone, a flying sword message quietly pierced through the air in the Second Elder's secret chamber—he had already sensed something amiss.

text.content: In that instant of blinding golden light, Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record in his palm come alive, the pages trembling violently as if roaring in silence. He took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing that restless sensation, his gaze assteady as an abyss. The prophecy had been forcibly overwritten, meaning someone was interfering with his plans—and among the entire Tianqing Sect, no more than three people could accomplish this. "Three days..." he murmured, his knuckles whitening from the pressure, "within three days, there will surely be a bloodbath."

dialogue.content: When Su Qingyao pushed open the door, she found Chen Ji standing alone by the window, the sunset stretching his shadow long and lonely. She frowned slightly, placing a stack of yellowed documents on the table: "I've already investigated thoroughly—the amount of spirit stones the Second Elder has secretly transferred over the years, along with copies of correspondence with the Xuanwu Sect." Her voice was cold as frost, "Enough to kill him ten times."

A black shadow swooped in from the window, Ye Qing's body surrounded by a faint aura of demonic energy, yet somehow not out of place at this moment. She glanced at Su Qingyao, a meaningful smile curling her lips: "Eldest Sister Su is quite diligent." Her expression then grew solemn, "However, I've come today for another matter—the Holy Sect has received news. During the Sect Council three days from now, they will send people to 'observe.'"

text.content: Chen Ji turned around, his gaze sweeping between the two women. One was the senior disciple of a prestigious righteous sect, the other an unparalleled saintess from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path, yet both now stood on his side. A complex emotion surged in his heart, though his face remained unruffled: "Does the Demonic Path want to take advantage of the chaos?" Ye Qing shook her head: "Not to take advantage—to collect the corpses. They're certain the Tianqing Sect will fall into civil strife during the Council, planning to reap the spoils."

dialogue.content: Just then, a timid voice came from the doorway. Chen Nian poked half her head in; upon seeing everyone in the room, she clearly froze for a moment, then her gaze fell on Chen Ji, her eyes reddening: "Brother, I... I've brought what you asked for." She took out an ancient jade pendant from her bosom—this was a ancestral heirloom of the Chen family, and also one of the key pieces of evidence proving the Second Elder's frame-up of the Chen family years ago.

text.content: Chen Ji stepped forward quickly, pulling his sister behind him, scanning her thoroughly to confirm she was unharmed before exhaling slightly in relief. He took the jade pendant, his fingertips tracing the patterns on its surface, his eyes gradually sharpening: "When the Second Elder forged the treasonous letter back then, he used the seal of this jade pendant. As long as we can prove the pendant has always been in the Chen family's possession, his lies will crumble on their own." Su Qingyao added: "Combined with the spirit stone accounts and correspondence in my hands, this forms a complete chain of evidence."

choice.prompt: The Sect Council three days later is crucial. Chen Ji needs to make a choice among the following plans:

choices.text: Advance Steadily, Move Step by Step
choices.description: Collect evidence methodically, publicly expose the Second Elder at the Council Hall three days later to ensure certainty
choices.visible_cost: Time-consuming, may miss the best opportunity
choices.visible_reward: Complete chain of evidence, extremely high success rate of exposure
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may have time to counterattack

text.content: After contemplating briefly, Chen Ji's fingers tapped lightly on the table: "Very well, we'll advance steadily. During these three days, I trouble Junior Sister Su to continue perfecting the chain of evidence, Miss Ye Qing to monitor the Demonic Path's movements, and Nian Nian to stay in the secret chamber without going out." His voice was calm, yet carried an unquestionable resolve, "In three days, I want the Second Elder to die knowing exactly why."

choices.description: Take advantage of the enemy's unpreparedness, launch a surprise attack tonight and strike before they can react
choices.visible_cost: Insufficient preparation time, may have oversights
choices.risk_hint: Incomplete chain of evidence, the force of exposure may be insufficient

text.content: A fierce light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes: "No need to wait three days. In war, speed is everything. Tonight, I'll personally go meet the Second Elder." Su Qingyao started to speak, then stopped, ultimately just nodding. Ye Qing laughed aloud: "Interesting, Young Master Chen is indeed not someone who settles for being passive." Chen Nian tightly gripped her brother's sleeve, her face full of worry.

choices.text: Dual Approach, Combine Overt and Covert
choices.description: On the surface, remain stationary; covertly arrange multiple layers of insurance to ensure absolute certainty
choices.visible_cost: Requires coordination across multiple parties, significant energy expenditure
choices.visible_reward: Can advance or retreat, stand in an invincible position
choices.risk_hint: Many links involved, any single mistake may expose the plan

text.content: Chen Ji slowly curled his lips, that smile carrying a chilling calculation that made one's blood run cold: "On the surface, we stay put. In the shadows..." He lowered his voice, laying out his entire plan. After listening, a flash of surprise and admiration appeared in Su Qingyao's eyes: "You plan to plant an informant near the Second Elder?" Chen Ji nodded: "Not only plant one, but make him reveal his own mistakes."

Su Qingyao suddenly spoke, her voice carrying a softness she herself wasn't aware of: "Chen Ji, have you really thought this through? Once you publicly expose him at the Council Hall, there's no going back." She looked at this man once deemed worthless, a strange feeling rising in her heart—as if he had already calculated everything, including her appearance.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing suddenly moved closer to Chen Ji, whispering near his ear: "There's one more thing—the fluctuations of the Tianji Record have already been detected by the Holy Sect. They think some treasure is emerging here and are sending people to investigate." She paused, "I can help conceal your aura, but at most for half a day." Chen Ji's eyes flashed—half a day... enough for him to do many things.

text.content: Chen Nian timidly tugged at her brother's sleeve: "Brother, on my way here just now, I felt like someone was following me..." Chen Ji's expression tightened, the Tianji Record in his palm warming slightly. He closed his eyes, his mind racing—if it was the Second Elder's people, it meant the enemy was already on guard; if it was from the Demonic Path or Xuanwu Sect, the situation was more complex than he imagined.

choice.prompt: After learning of the possible tail, Chen Ji needs to decide on the next move:

choices.text: Turn the Tables, Lure the Snake Out of its Hole
choices.description: Deliberately expose weaknesses, lead the follower to a preset location, capture and interrogate them in one swoop

text.content: Chen Ji sneered: "Since they want to come, let them." He turned to Ye Qing, "Trouble the young lady to set up a restraining formation. I want to see personally who's behind this." Ye Qing raised an eyebrow: "Interesting. I like your ruthlessness." Her fingertips flicked, and faint demonic energy began spreading through the room. Chen Nian hid behind her brother, fists clenched tightly.

choices.description: Ignore the follower, focus on the plan for three days later; when the enemy moves, they'll reveal more weaknesses
choices.visible_cost: May leak information to the enemy
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength, focus on the main objective
choices.risk_hint: The enemy may gain more intelligence

text.content: Chen Ji shook his head: "No need to respond. The more critical the moment, the steadier we must remain." He looked at Su Qingyao, "The real battle is in three days. No need to rush. If the follower wanted to act, they would have done so already. They're just probing." A flash of approval appeared in Su Qingyao's eyes: "You're calmer than I imagined." Chen Ji replied coolly: "Rashness is the first step toward failure."

Night deepened, yet the atmosphere in the secret chamber grew heavier. Su Qingyao reorganized the stack of evidence, categorizing and labeling them clearly; Ye Qing carved formation runes on the side, preparing for the impending battle; Chen Nian sat quietly in the corner, her gaze always on her brother, as if just looking at him brought peace of mind.

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao suddenly spoke: "By the way, there's something I almost forgot." She took out a token from her sleeve, "This is a Council Token bestowed by the Sect Master. With it, you can speak directly at the Council Hall without going through intermediaries." She pushed the token toward Chen Ji, "The Sect Master may be elderly, but he's not entirely ignorant of the Second Elder's deeds."

text.content: Chen Ji took the token, his fingertips tracing the patterns on its surface, a complex emotion rising in his heart. Sect Master Ling Yuan... that seemingly benevolent old man—is he truly just a bystander? He closed his eyes, the fragments of the Tianji Record surfacing in his mind, countless clues weaving into a vast net, and he himself was the one who had woven this net.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing suddenly stopped her movements, listening intently before frowning: "There's movement outside—at least three experts are approaching." She looked at Chen Ji, "The Second Elder's people, roughly at Foundation Building late stage." Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, even a cold smile curling his lips: "Perfect timing. I'd like to see what the Second Elder is truly capable of."

text.content: Before the words finished, the secret chamber door was blown open by a tremendous force. Three black shadows filed in. The leader wore an elder's robe—it was the Executive Elder Zhao Kun, the Second Elder's trusted confidant. He scanned the room, his gaze finally landing on Chen Ji, and coldly laughed: "Chen Ji, gathering privately in the middle of the night and consorting with demonic path vixens—do you know your crimes?"

choice.prompt: Facing Zhao Kun's accusation, Chen Ji chooses:

choices.text: Draw Sword Directly, Overwhelm with Strength
choices.description: Stop hiding, reveal true combat power, subdue these lackeys on the spot
choices.visible_reward: Intimidate the enemy, seize the initiative
choices.risk_hint: May attract attention from higher authorities

dialogue.content: Chen Ji didn't speak, only waving one hand. A fierce sword qi pierced through the air, instantly slicing off a corner of Zhao Kun's sleeve. Zhao Kun's face changed dramatically, retreating several steps, disbelief plastered across his features: "You... you've already formed a Golden Core?" Chen Ji rose slowly, his imposing aura as heavy as a mountain: "Executive Elder Zhao, I advise you to go back and tell the Second Elder one thing—those who do evil will surely destroy themselves."

choices.description: Counter with evidence and logic, publicly expose the connection between Zhao Kun and the Second Elder on the spot, leaving the opponent speechless
choices.visible_reward: Don't expose strength, can still occupy the moral high ground

dialogue.content: Chen Ji calmly took out the stack of evidence from his chest, speaking unhurriedly: "Executive Elder Zhao, you've come at the perfect time. The spirit stone accounts embezzled by the Second Elder, the correspondence with the Xuanwu Sect—shall I read them all to you?" Zhao Kun's face instantly turned deathly pale, his lips trembling as he couldn't speak. Chen Ji pressed on relentlessly: "Or would you prefer to face judgment together with the Second Elder at the Council Hall three days from now?"

text.content: Beads of cold sweat formed on Zhao Kun's forehead, his gaze unconsciously glancing at the two subordinates behind him. Those two also exchanged uncertain looks, clearly not expecting to踢到铁板 today. Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, a hint of indifferent smile on his lips: "Executive Elder Zhao, you may return to report. During the Sect Council three days from now, the Second Elder is welcome to appear in person for confrontation."

After Zhao Kun retreated狼狈 from the secret chamber, the atmosphere inside didn't fully relax. Ye Qing put away the restraining formation, looking at Chen Ji with an amused expression: "That sword just now exposed at least thirty percent of your strength." Chen Ji made no comment: "Sometimes, appropriately displaying strength is more effective than hiding it constantly." Su Qingyao frowned: "Zhao Kun will certainly report tonight's events to the Second Elder. We must prepare for the worst."

Chen Ji nodded, his gaze sweeping across everyone present: "The three-day agreement is set. During these three days, everyone has their own tasks." He began assigning duties one by one, "Junior Sister Su is responsible for perfecting the chain of evidence, ensuring it's airtight; Miss Ye Qing continues monitoring the Demonic Path's movements, and if necessary, can create some 'accidents' to delay them; Nian Nian stays in the secret chamber and doesn't go out unless absolutely necessary." He paused, "As for me..."

dialogue.content: Chen Nian suddenly raised her head, eyes reddening: "Brother, where are you going?" Chen Ji walked over, gently rubbing her hair, and said softly: "I need to see someone, someone who might help us." Su Qingyao pondered: "You mean... the Sect Master?" Chen Ji didn't answer, only gazing at the night sky outside the window, his eyes reflecting a complex brilliance. Three days... the time remaining for him was running out.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji was finalizing the details with everyone, a flying sword message quietly pierced through the air in the Second Elder's secret chamber—Zhao Kun knelt on the ground, trembling as he reported everything that happened tonight. After reading the letter, an icy cold smile appeared on the Second Elder's aged face: "Chen Ji... What an excellent case of hiding one's strength to ambush others. Since you want to play, this old man will play along to the end." He summoned his confidant, quietly giving several instructions, murder evident in his eyes. Before the three-day agreement even began, the identities of hunter and hunted had already quietly reversed.
